sar.narrative: Customer C10990, holder of card C10990-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-21 16:00 and 2016-11-21 16:24, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,926.93 were made on the card online from device profile 'Windows |  | chrome 63.0 | ': $477.19 (3475933, 2016-11-21 16:00), $484.81 (3475959, 2016-11-21 16:08), $468.87 (3475998, 2016-11-21 16:22), $496.06 (3476008, 2016-11-21 16:24). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 24 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($477.19, $484.81, $468.87, $496.06; total $1,926.93). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
